title: PDI retention-transform compatibility
question: Is the existing z=logit((theta-theta_r)/(theta_s-theta_r)) representation mathematically valid over the source-authoritative PDI retention domain, and if not, what source-defined bounded state variable can replace it without breaking theta/C derivative consistency?
diagnostics: head where theta first falls below theta_r
candidate direct transformed theta using logit(theta/theta_s) where 0<theta<theta_s
decision_rule: If legacy Se leaves (0,1), the existing retention transform is rejected for PDI. A replacement transform may proceed only if it stays bounded/monotone over the qualified domain and its analytic derivative reconstructs C from the same interpolant.
